# Architecture Essential

<!-- GENERATED BY flutter-agents. Intentionally small because it is part of base context. -->

- `docs/PROJECT-STACK.md` identifies the active architecture and package profiles.
- Existing projects preserve established structure and conventions unless migration is explicit.
- New projects follow the selected architecture profile without creating empty layers merely for symmetry.
- Shared/app infrastructure must not depend on feature implementation details.
- Feature-specific code stays with its feature unless there is proven cross-feature reuse.
- UI renders state and owns UI side effects; business/state layers do not navigate or show UI feedback.
- Network calls follow the project's established repository/service boundary.
- Package availability comes from `pubspec.yaml`; package-specific behavior comes from active profile + existing project convention.
- Use `docs/project/PROJECT-RULES.md` for intentional project-specific overrides that should survive CLI sync/update.
